'''Volume 4''' is the fourth volume published {{pkmn|in France}} by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Black & White}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. As the chapters of the ''Black & White'' arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* [[N]] reveals that he is [[Team Plasma]]'s king.
* [[Gigi]] betrays {{adv|White}} for N.
* N gives White a {{adv|Amanda|Servine}}.
* {{adv|Black}} meets [[Marshal]] and [[Alder]].
* White decides to become a Pokémon Trainer and learn about battling.
* White and Black go their separate ways.
* Black lends White Brav.
* Black meets [[Clay]].
* White meets [[Shauntal]].
* Team Plasma captures {{p|Tornadus}}, {{p|Thundurus}}, and {{p|Landorus}}.
* Black meets up with {{adv|Cheren}} again.
